entries.question: I want a appointment for kardiology
entries.answer:
To book an appointment for Cardiology (LARI Cardiology), you can use any of the following methods. Please note that online pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times:

**1. Online Booking (Recommended)**
*   Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in)
*   Register/Login, select **Uttar Pradesh** as the state and **King George's Medical University** as the hospital.
*   Select the **Cardiology** department, choose your preferred date, and pay the ₹50 fee online to generate your appointment slip.

**2. Mobile App**
*   Download the **ABHA** or **ORS** app from the KGMU Play Store and follow the same booking steps as the website.

**3. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the format: `APPOINTMENT <Your Name>` to **8887019134**. You will receive a booking confirmation.

**4. On-Site Walk-in**
*   You can visit the hospital registration counter with your **Aadhaar card** and an active mobile number.
*   **Important:** OPD registration counters are open from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM (Monday–Friday) and 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM (Saturday). They are closed on Sundays.
*   The flat fee for an OPD slip is ₹50.

**Important Reminders:**
*   **Referral:** If you are visiting from outside Lucknow, please carry a valid medical referral for the Cardiology department.
*   **Emergency:** If this is a cardiac emergency, do not wait for an OPD appointment. Please proceed directly to the **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)** or the **LARI Cardiology** emergency services immediately.

I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.

1. **Website Check Karein:** Sabhi courses aur admission se sambandhit jaankari [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) par uplabdh hai.
2. **Admission Portal:** KGMU mein admission ke liye alag-alag courses ke liye entrance exam hote hain. Aapko website par **"Admissions"** ya **"Academic"** section mein jakar apne pasandida course ka brochure aur eligibility criteria dekhna hoga.
3. **Important Links:** 
   - Course ki list aur admission ki prakriya dekhne ke liye: [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php)
   - Exam aur Result ki jankari ke liye: [https://kgmu.org/kgmu_result/examination_result.php](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_result/examination_result.php)

**Kya aap kisi specific course (jaise ki Nursing, Paramedical, ya MBBS/MD) ke bare mein janna chahti hain?** Agar aap mujhe course ka naam batayengi, toh main aapko usse sambandhit adhik sahi jankari de paunga.

*Main ek AI assistant hoon jise Dr. Ayush Yadav dwara banaya gaya hai. Main sirf website par uplabdh jankari dene mein aapki sahayata kar sakta hoon.*

entries.answer:
To book an appointment for the Cardiology Department (LARI Cardiology), you can use any of the following methods:

**1. Online Booking (Recommended)**
*   **Website:** Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in).
*   **Process:** Register/Login → Select Uttar Pradesh → Select KGMU → Click 'New Appointment' → Choose the Cardiology department → Select your preferred date and time slot → Pay the ₹50 fee online.

**2. Mobile App**
*   Download the **ABHA** or **Health Care** app from the KGMU Play Store.
*   Register using your mobile number and follow the same steps as the ORS portal to book your appointment.

**3. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the format: **"APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>"** to **8887019134**. You will receive a confirmation regarding your booking.

**4. Walk-in Registration (On-Site)**
*   You can visit the registration counter at KGMU.
*   **Requirements:** You must bring the patient’s **Aadhaar card** and an active mobile number to receive an OTP for verification.
*   **Fee:** ₹50 (payable at the counter).
*   **Note:** Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times. The registration counters close at 1:00 PM (Monday–Friday) and 12:00 PM (Saturday).

**Important Information:**
*   **Outside-city patients:** If you are traveling from outside Lucknow, please ensure you carry a valid referral letter for the Cardiology department.
*   **Emergency:** If this is a medical emergency, please go directly to the **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)** for stabilization first.
*   **PRO Office (LARI Cardiology):** You can reach the PRO office for LARI Cardiology at **9415099528**.

*I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.*
